rendered: The pouch cell was a 1.4 Ah[1] lithium-ion pouch cell. It was cycled at 1 C/2 C[2] rates for 1000[3] cycles, and its capacity degraded to 65.7%[4] of its initial capacity. So the cell kept 65.7%[5] of its capacity over 1000[6] cycles. For the NMC622 cathode, the lithium content measured by ICP-OES was reduced from 1.015[7] to 0.993[8] after delamination. This is a fall of 2.2%[9] in lithium content, relative to the pre-delamination value.
